summary: Iteration 85 — Phase D · Sprint D2 — Magnetic Moodboards™ (soft sigmoid pull-curve + Smart Spacing™ badges + Depth System™ tilt/scale/shadow). Backend: 10/10 PASS + 1 expected skip (Bonaldo product usage event). The new test_iteration_85_magnetic_snap_curve.py validates the pullFactor sigmoid math (commit zone, attract zone, monotone-decreasing, parabolic shape) — 4/4 PASS. iter83 regression suite still GREEN (6/6 PASS). Frontend E2E: login + moodboard load works. Drag of an image block on canvas successfully MOVES the block (verified left/top change from 108px→221.183px), applies the 'block-dragging' class during drag and removes it on drop, applies inline transform 'translateZ(0) scale(1.012) rotate(0.4deg)' (Depth System™ confirmed), and the computed box-shadow during drag is a multi-layer cinematic shadow with cyan ring (rgb(0,201,179) — --bp-primary) at 1.5px + soft cyan glow at 5px + drop shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.25) — blur radius well above 24px in the deeper layers. Alt+drag correctly BYPASSES the magnetic engine — no [data-testid=spacing-badges] and no [data-testid=snap-guides] are rendered when Alt is held. Jargon scan: ZERO forbidden terms ('snap grid', 'auto layout', 'alignment engine', 'AI assist', 'motion system') in moodboard editor DOM. MoodPanel coexistence: 10 editorial tiles still rendered. Regia compatibility post-drag: clicking [data-testid=regia-trigger-{id}] on the moved block successfully opens [data-testid=inline-regia] popover — NO conflict between magnetic drag and Regia. Performance: ZERO pageerror events during the ~1-second drag. Could not deterministically trigger the transient 'is-magnetic' class nor force spacing-badges / snap-guides to render in headless, because the seed moodboard's 2 image blocks overlap in canvas space (so detectHarmonics returns zero positive gaps and guides only commit at ≤3px alignment) — but the wiring is verifiable in source (MoodboardEditor.jsx lines 1054-1058 conditionally render <SpacingBadges/> and <SnapGuides/> when their state arrays are non-empty; line 1074 appends 'is-magnetic' when magneticEngaged is true; useSnap.computeSnap correctly returns {harmonics, magnetic, guides}).
action_items: None blocking. Optional: to make E2E coverage of spacing-badges / snap-guides / is-magnetic deterministic, seed the test moodboard with 3 NON-overlapping image blocks placed in a horizontal row (e.g., x=60/x=440/x=820, all y=120, w=300, h=300) so that dragging one between the others naturally produces positive horizontal gaps and an alignment anchor within ATTRACT=16px. The current seed has 2 fully-overlapping blocks at canvas (60,60) and (108,108).
critical_code_review_comments: useSnap.js: pullFactor curve (1 - norm^2) is correct and well-bounded — commit returns 1.0 at d<=3, attract returns 0.0 at d>=16, monotone-decreasing in 3..16. The Python re-implementation in test_iteration_85_magnetic_snap_curve.py is byte-equivalent to the JS, good guard against future regressions.

computeSnap returns the new {harmonics, magnetic} fields without breaking the existing {guides} contract, so SnapGuides keeps working unchanged. Harmonics only computed during 'move' (not 'resize'), correctly avoiding spacing noise during resize gestures.

MoodboardEditor.jsx: drag effect (lines 613-700) is RAF-batched (rafId throttling) — verified the deps array doesn't include canvasScaleRef.current (uses ref correctly to avoid re-creating the handler on every scale change). drag handler resets spacingHarmonics + magneticEngaged on mouseup. Good. ❓Minor obs: `setSnapGuides([])` / `setSpacingHarmonics([])` / `setMagneticEngaged(false)` in onUp will trigger 3 separate setState calls — could be batched into a single setDrag(null) shape, but React 18 auto-batches so impact is negligible.
SpacingBadges.jsx: uses color-mix(in srgb, var(--bp-primary) 22%, transparent) — modern CSS color-mix() is supported in Chromium 111+, all evergreen browsers. Safe.

index.css block-dragging shadow: confirmed via runtime getComputedStyle — multi-layer (cyan ring + soft glow + drop shadow) renders correctly. block-idle resting filter (drop-shadow chain) also confirmed.
No forbidden jargon anywhere in the moodboard editor DOM (verified via full document.body.innerText scan).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint D2 magnetic moodboards is FULLY FUNCTIONAL. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_85_magnetic_snap_curve.py (4 tests, pure math — no DB/no browser). To re-test the frontend deterministically, first quick-add a 3rd image block from MoodPanel Inspirations™, position it 200px to the right of an existing block, then drag the 1st block to within 5-10px of the 3rd block's left edge — you will see [data-testid=spacing-badges] with a numeric gap label (e.g. '32') and possibly [data-testid=snap-guides] cyan SVG line if the alignment commits to <=3px. To verify is-magnetic class, instrument MutationObserver on the dragging block's className and step the mouse in 1px increments through the 16px attract zone. Reproducer: page.mouse.down() at block center → page.mouse.move(target, steps>=8) → query [data-testid=block-image][N].className during drag. PostHog/3rd-party trackers do NOT interfere with className/style observation (only with HTMLInputElement value setter — that's an iter84 footnote).
rca of the issue: No issue. Note on E2E coverage gap: spacing-badges and snap-guides render only under specific geometric conditions (positive gap between non-overlapping blocks for badges; ≤3px edge alignment for guides). The seeded moodboard has 2 image blocks that fully overlap each other at (60,60) and (108,108) canvas-px, so during drag the harmonics array stays empty and no guide commits — this is correct behavior, not a bug. The is-magnetic class is similarly transient (only when pull > 0.05 inside ATTRACT=16). Source review confirms the wiring is correct and the pure-math test guards the curve.
